purpose: Preview mockups; original generated images, not installed app icons

variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: concept mockup of a macOS APPLICATION icon for TrayNook, not a menu bar glyph.
Primary request: one original cute TANUKI lying down curled into a compact circle like a sleeping fox, physically hugging a large simple inbox TRAY symbol with both front paws. The animal is reclining, not sitting upright. Its head rests on the tray rim, eyes closed peacefully, body and thick fluffy tail curl around the tray protectively. The tray is a shallow straight-sided U/inbox shape with a broad rim and a small central notch like the familiar macOS tray.full symbol, NOT a serving platter, not a basket, not a suitcase. Keep the front face and notch visible so the tray symbol is immediately readable.
Tanuki identity: short broad muzzle, broad cream cheeks, small rounded ears, brown/copper fur, distinct charcoal eye patches, thick mostly solid brown tail. No long pointed fox ears, no fox white tail-tip, no raccoon tail stripes. One head, two ears, two front paws.
Composition: centered large single subject fills about 78 percent of a standard macOS continuous-corner rounded-square SQUIRCLE app tile. All ears, paws and tail stay inside the tile. Squircle silhouette clearly visible, equal rounded corners. Straight-on orthographic app icon presentation, not perspective packaging or a desktop screenshot. One icon only, no variations, no grid.
Constraints: no letters, words, labels, watermarks, accessory objects, leaf emblems, clothes, sparkles, or UI screenshots. Original mascot. Strong uncluttered silhouette, readable at small icon sizes. Square output. Show complete icon tile with a narrow neutral margin outside its squircle.
Style: premium soft sculpted 3D macOS app icon, clay-like smooth broad forms, extremely restrained fur detail, warm copper and cream tanuki hugging an ivory enamel inbox tray. Deep midnight-navy squircle background with very gentle tonal gradient. Three-quarter reclining curled pose, sleepy head on the tray's upper-left rim, tail wraps around the lower outside in a near-circle. Soft upper-left studio light, delicate contact shadow, polished but not glossy toy plastic. Tray large and high contrast. Overall cozy, beautifully balanced, professional utility app.
